# `passportsim ui`

Read the pruned LVGL tree, or only the lines that changed since a revision.

| MCP tool | Scenario step | macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passport_ui` | `ui.snapshot` | yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim ui [--diff <DIFF>] [--include-style] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--max-nodes <MAX_NODES>] [--prune <PRUNE>] [--resolve <RESOLVE>] [--timeout <TIMEOUT>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `diff` | `--diff <DIFF>` | `integer` | no | Only lines changed since this ui_rev. |
| `include_style` | `--include-style` | `boolean` | no | Show local style colours (false). |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `max_nodes` | `--max-nodes <MAX_NODES>` | `integer` | no | Lines to show (300). |
| `prune` | `--prune <PRUNE>` | `"semantic"` \| `"none"` | no | Pruning (semantic). |
| `resolve` | `--resolve <RESOLVE>` | `string` | no | Resolve a ref from an earlier revision. |
| `timeout` | `--timeout <TIMEOUT>` | `union` | no | Run to a safe point first, 1s. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

## Errors

`E_USAGE` (1), `E_STATE` (2), `E_STALE_REF` (3), `E_LEASE` (6), `E_INTERNAL` (17). What each means: [errors.md](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Read the pruned tree

```sh
passportsim ui --json - <<'JSON'
{}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{}
'@ | passportsim ui --json -
```

### Read only what changed since revision 3

```sh
passportsim ui --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "diff": 3
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "diff": 3
}
'@ | passportsim ui --json -
```

### Show every object with its local style colours

```sh
passportsim ui --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "include_style": true,
  "prune": "none"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "include_style": true,
  "prune": "none"
}
'@ | passportsim ui --json -
```
